access.description:
Default s3 permissions: [s3:GetBucketLocation, s3:ListAllMyBuckets]
Additional permissions:
	* Read                             [s3:GetObject, s3:ListMultipartUploadParts]
	* Write                            [s3:PutObject, s3:AbortMultipartUpload]
	* Delete                           [s3:DeleteObject]
	* List                             [s3:ListBucket, s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads]
	* GetBucketVersioning              [s3:GetBucketVersioning]
	* GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration [s3:GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration]
	* ListBucketVersions               [s3:ListBucketVersions]
	* GetObjectVersion                 [s3:GetObjectVersion]
	* GetObjectRetention               [s3:GetObjectRetention]
	* GetObjectLegalHold               [s3:GetObjectLegalHold]
	* PutObjectRetention               [s3:PutObjectRetention]
	* PutObjectLegalHold               [s3:PutObjectLegalHold]
	* DeleteObjectVersion              [s3:DeleteObjectVersion]

physicalSizeBytes.description: physical size of backed-up snapshot on image store

state.description: the state of the snapshot. BackedUpSnapshot means that the snapshot is ready to be used; Creating - the snapshot is being allocated on the primary storage; BackingUp - the snapshot is being backed up on secondary storage

virtualSizeBytes.description: virtual size of backed-up snapshot on image store

x-enum-comments.ACTIVE: ACTIVE allows full access (read, write, delete).
x-enum-comments.DISABLED: DISABLED denies all actions for the tenant.
x-enum-comments.LOCKED: LOCKED makes the tenant read-only (no writes or deletes).
x-enum-comments.WRITE_LOCKED: WRITE_LOCKED blocks writes but still allows reads and deletes.

x-enum-descriptions: DISABLED denies all actions for the tenant.
LOCKED makes the tenant read-only (no writes or deletes).
WRITE_LOCKED blocks writes but still allows reads and deletes.
ACTIVE allows full access (read, write, delete).

info.description: Every action available in the Aurora Portal can be automated through these REST endpoints, authenticated with an API token.
info.title: Aurora Portal API

get.description: Returns inference usage metrics (token counts, requests, errors) for the authenticated tenant in the given time range, optionally resampled by window duration and grouped by model

parameters.description: Resample window duration, e.g., 5m, 1h. Minutes and hours are the only supported units
parameters.name: window

get.description: Returns S3 operation metrics for a bucket, optionally filtered by requester tenant and grouped by tags

parameters.description: Resample window duration, e.g., 5m, 1h. Minutes and hours are the only supported units
parameters.name: window

parameters.description: Filter metrics to a requester tenant ID
parameters.name: requesterTenantId

get.description: Returns S3 operation metrics for the authenticated tenant in the given time range, optionally resampled by window duration and grouped by tags

parameters.description: Resample window duration, e.g., 5m, 1h. Minutes and hours are the only supported units
parameters.name: window

get.description: Returns storage metrics for a bucket owned by the authenticated tenant

parameters.description: Resample window duration, e.g., 5m, 1h. Minutes and hours are the only supported units
parameters.name: window

get.description: Returns storage metrics for the authenticated tenant in the given time range, optionally resampled by window duration

parameters.description: Resample window duration, e.g., 5m, 1h. Minutes and hours are the only supported units
parameters.name: window
